vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: E0: accept request, latch data_in=0xA5; expect busy=1, sclk=0, mosi=1, done=0.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: E1: first sclk low-to-high; shift to bit6, sclk=1.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: E2-E7 continued toggling; data_in held 0 during busy must not alter latched frame.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: E8-E11; drive data_in=0xFF during busy to confirm no latch rewrite.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: E15: final sclk low-to-high; expect busy=0, done=1, sclk=1, mosi=bit0.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: E16 idle edge: expect sclk=0, done=0, mosi holds bit0.

vectors.name: agent_7_6
vectors.rationale: E0 of chained start right at idle edge; expect accept with data_in=0x0F.

vectors.name: agent_8_7
vectors.rationale: E1-E2: start held high during busy and data_in changed mid-transfer; must not rewrite current frame.

vectors.name: agent_9_8
vectors.rationale: Async reset asserted mid/after activity; expect outputs cleared (sclk=0,mosi=0,busy=0,done=0).

vectors.name: agent_10_9
vectors.rationale: Release reset then start=1 within one edge; observe re-send acceptance after reset.

vectors.name: agent_11_10
vectors.rationale: Post-restart transfer begins; confirm busy asserted and sclk toggling from reset state.

vectors.name: agent_6_5

plan.objective: Check contract behavior and protocol boundaries

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: Four accepted writes (full=0 before each until last) fill DEPTH=4; wr_data held at 17 for all writes.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: full=1 before edge, so this write must be rejected and occupancy unchanged.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: empty=0 before each edge, accepted reads return retained items in write order, moving away from full.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: Mid-occupancy with both enables: both accepted if non-empty/non-full before edge; net occupancy unchanged and old data read.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Drain remaining items with simultaneous operations, causing read/write pointer wrap-around and checking retained order across wrap.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: Hold async reset asserted for the automatic reset window, then assert on the final cycle release cycle; DUT stays empty/invalid.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: Empty stage accepts one item even with out_ready=0; after edge out_valid=1 and out_data=0xA5.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: Full stage with out_ready=0 enters backpressure; in_ready=0 and out_valid/out_data must hold 0xA5 despite blocked new in_data=0x5A.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: With out_ready=1 the old item is consumed and the new item accepted on the same edge; out_data becomes 0x3C and out_valid stays 1.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Consume the last item without refill: after the edge out_valid=0 while out_data holds the last data 0x3C per holding rule.

vectors.name: agent_5_4

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: out_valid=1 and out_ready=0 gives in_ready=0; held cycles must keep out_valid/out_data and must not overwrite the buffered item.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: Pre-edge out_valid&&out_ready consumes the buffered item while in_ready=1 accepts new data, so out_data replaces with 0x3C and out_valid stays 1.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: Pre-edge consumption with in_valid=0 drains the level: out_valid falls to 0 while out_data holds the last value; in_data change must not be captured.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: No request with advance=1 must not advance the pointer; grant stays 0.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: Old pointer 0 selects position 0; advance moves pointer to 1.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: Pointer 1 selects the first set request at position 2; advance=0 holds pointer at 1.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: Pointer still 1 wraps cyclically to position 0; advance moves pointer to 1.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Pointer 1 selects position 3 (bit 3) over bit 1, verifying cyclic priority; advance moves pointer to 0.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: From pointer 0 selects position 0 again, confirming wrap and pointer update to 1.

vectors.name: agent_7_6
vectors.rationale: Final no-request edge must output 0 and leave pointer unchanged despite advance=1.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: Asynchronous reset asserted with requests and advance high: grant must be 0 and pointer forced to 0 despite business inputs.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: After reset pointer is 0, so request bit 1 is selected; advance moves pointer to 2.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: No request with advance high: grant 0 and priority pointer holds at 2 rather than advancing.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: Pointer held at 2 selects the requested bit 3 over any lower set bit, and advance=0 keeps pointer at 2.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: Assert async reset for two cycles, forcing output and window clear before any trigger.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: First sampled high at E0 should immediately assert pulse_out and open a 4-cycle window including E0.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: No retrigger: output should stay high through E3 and fall at E4, checking the full WIDTH boundary and low input not cancelling the window.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: After low cycles, a later high would restart the window; this vector's low tail prepares a reachable retrigger path.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Held-high inputs refresh the window each edge; after the last high sample three further high-output edges should remain, testing refresh and tail-off behavior.

vectors.rationale: Old/new 0/1 pair must pulse rising=1 after this edge.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: Held-high consecutive samples must not repeat the pulse; covers stateful held-input rule.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Sampled 0 after a plateau yields rising=0 and arms a new rising edge.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: New 0/1 transition after returning low must pulse again.

vectors.name: agent_7_6
vectors.rationale: Assert reset while input high to clear old sample and output, checking reset priority and history clearing.

vectors.name: agent_8_7
vectors.rationale: First sampled high after reset must count as a rising edge from cleared history 0.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: Establish idle before the start pulse.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: E0 rising edge accepts data_in=0x96 and latches the frame.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: Hold data_in changed and start high through the frame; busy must ignore start, tx follows the latched 0x96 LSB-first timing, and stop bits are high.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: E40 end edge releases busy to 0 and tx to 1; start is dropped for the next frame.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Confirm idle tx=1 and busy=0 after the frame.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: E41 or later idle edge re-accepts a new frame, data_in=0x3A. Probe without completing the second full frame to stay within budget.

plan.objective: Check contract behavior and protocol boundaries

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: After reset, drive one high pulse at cycle 1, then hold input low for 5 cycles; output should be high for the trigger edge and the following three edges, then fall at the fifth edge.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: Hold pulse_in low for five consecutive cycles to observe the window expiry boundary without retriggering.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: Restart from reset, trigger at cycle 1, hold low at cycle 2, retrigger at cycle 3 (E2), then hold low for four cycles; window restarts to keep output high through E5 and drop at E6.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: Provide one low cycle between trigger and retrigger so the retrigger occurs at the documented E2 boundary.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Assert pulse_in high at the E2 edge to restart the full WIDTH=4 window.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: Hold input low after the retrigger for four cycles to observe output falling at E6 if no further trigger occurs.

vectors.rationale: E0 acceptance edge: busy goes 1, tx 0 (start bit begins).

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: Start bit E0-E3 held low, then data[0]=0 at E4.

vectors.name: agent_8_7
vectors.rationale: data[7]=1 (E32), stop bit 1 begins E36; busy still 1.

vectors.name: agent_9_8
vectors.rationale: E36-E39 stop bit 1, then E40 release: busy 0, tx 1.

vectors.name: agent_10_9
vectors.rationale: Idle after release remains high; start low so no retrigger.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: E16 idle edge clears sclk and done; with start=1 a new frame may be accepted with data 0x3C.

vectors.name: agent_6_5
vectors.rationale: Observe first two busy edges of second frame (E1/E2) with start low, checking new latched data bit7/bit6 behavior.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: Synchronous-free async reset assertion per contract (2 cycles).

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: Empty stage accepts one item even with out_ready=0; out_valid should rise after edge.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: out_valid=1,out_ready=0 gives in_ready=0; out_valid/out_data must hold across cycles while in_data attempt is blocked.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: out_ready=1 makes in_ready=1; same edge consumes buffered item and accepts new one, out_data replaces.

vectors.name: agent_5_4
vectors.rationale: Consume without refill: edge-before out_valid&out_ready drives consumption; no input means out_valid falls after edge, out_data retained.

vectors.name: agent_1_0
vectors.rationale: E0: accept request, latch A5 (10100101), drive mosi with bit7=1 while busy=1.

vectors.name: agent_2_1
vectors.rationale: E1..E14: sclk toggles each cycle, mosi walks bit6..bit0 of A5 with no re-latch.

vectors.name: agent_3_2
vectors.rationale: E15: last low-to-high, then busy=0, done=1, sclk=1, mosi=bit0=1, data_in change ignored.

vectors.name: agent_4_3
vectors.rationale: E16: idle edge clears sclk and done one cycle after the done pulse; mosi retains last bit.
